Congrats on the ride. I was scheduled to ride in the tour from Dallas to Oklahoma. I know that I can do the distance, but unfortunately I had heart surgery scheduled for this month that was rescheduled and turned into a bigger thing than originally discussed. I just don’t have enough recovery time to make sure that I can do it and I don’t want to commit if I can’t meet my obligations.

Again, congrats on the ride. 150 miles is certainly an accomplishment!

Michael Knox
What type of bike do you have?

I have a Schwinn frame with misc parts attached. The bikes from the store cost way too much money, and I think mine works just as good. It has the narrow 700 tires, handlebar shifters, clipless pedals, etc.
